description: Actual committed effects. Effects in one transaction share effect_seq. Advance effects are commit progress summaries, not simulator row audits.

columns.effect_ref: TEXT PRIMARY KEY. Stable operation reference plus local effect index.
columns.operation_ref: TEXT. Operation that produced this effect.
columns.effect_seq: INTEGER. Actual committed transaction segment order on the retained route.
columns.item_index: INTEGER. Zero-based effect order inside this segment.
columns.day: INTEGER. Simulation day at the commit.
columns.kind: TEXT. Public row insert/update/delete, runtime_config, or advance_progress.
columns.target_json: TEXT. Public target identity as JSON.
columns.before_json: TEXT. Public values before this effect, or JSON null.
columns.after_json: TEXT. Public values after this effect, or JSON null.
columns.applied_parameters_json: TEXT. Normalized applied public values as JSON.
columns.result_json: TEXT. Effect-specific public result as JSON.
